assessments.name: Group project presentation
assessments.description: This assignment assesses students' critical analysis of chosen learning and teaching practices and their ability to provide research-informed learning and teaching solutions (including technological solutions)

assessments.name: In-class written assessment
assessments.description: Assignment 1 (1hour, in-class) will examine whether students can demonstrate a critical, research-informed, science-informed and interdisciplinary understanding of learning and teaching processes.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Individual poster presentation
assessments.description: This assignment assesses students’ implementation of Design Thinking and culturally and contextually appropriate learning and teaching practices. Each student will give a short presentation on their own poster.
